verdict.rationale: Skyvern has a dedicated CAPTCHA docs page stating that its vision model detects and solves CAPTCHAs automatically. It names the supported types: reCAPTCHA v2/v3, hCaptcha, Cloudflare Turnstile, FunCaptcha/ArkoseLabs, MTCaptcha and text/image CAPTCHAs. Separately, browser sessions support human-in-the-loop pauses and VNC takeover, which could serve as a manual fallback, though the docs do not tie this to CAPTCHAs. Missing for 10: documented behavior when automatic solving fails (no explicit CAPTCHA-specific human fallback or error/failure signaling), and independent or hands-on confirmation that solving works.
